title: Granite Ridge Season Pass Schedule: Cancellation Window, Fee, Refund Basis and Day Use Deduction
content:
Four figures are published per tier of the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme for a pass the household gives up: the number of calendar days after the application is recorded within which the cancellation is honoured for a refund, the fee retained by the resort inside that window, the basis on which the refundable amount is worked out, and the amount deducted for each day already scanned on the pass.

| Tier | Cancellation window (calendar days) | Cancellation fee (USD) | Refund basis | Day use deduction (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | 10 | 75.00 | day use basis | 139.00 |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 14 | 75.00 | day use basis | 119.00 |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | 14 | 95.00 | day use basis | 109.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | 21 | 125.00 | day use basis | 139.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | 21 | 125.00 | pro rata basis | 149.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 30 | 150.00 | pro rata basis | 169.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | 45 | 195.00 | pro rata basis | 199.00 |

Two refund bases appear in the programme. On the four lower tiers the basis is the day use basis, which works from the price committed to and the days already scanned. On the Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass and the two collective tiers it is the pro rata basis, which works from the share of the season's operating days still to come.

The day use deduction is published on every tier, including the three whose refund basis is the pro rata basis. The window rises with the tier, from 10 calendar days on the Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass to 45 on the Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass, and so does the fee, from 75.00 to 195.00.
